verses: Then I saw the soul of a woman, on whose body they construct an iron coating, and they turn back the mouth, and put it back to a hot oven.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this woman?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who was, among the living, the wife of a well-disposed and intelligent man; and she broke her faith to her husband, and slept with a sinful and ill-disposed man.'
